description: Adjudicated real-PDF cases for held-out evaluation. Place PDFs in evaluation/real_pdfs/ or set an absolute pdf_path. Do not encode document-specific patches here; gold fields are adjudicated expectations only. The default catalog is the generated operations handbook (held_out_handbook.pdf).

schema.pdf_path: absolute path or filename under evaluation/real_pdfs/
schema.question: required for retrieval mode
schema.answer: gold answer containing [E1] (optional; default is claim_text [E1])
schema.chunk_id: optional localization hint; resolved from expected_quote_substring when omitted
schema.expected_page: 1-based PDF page the claim must land on
schema.expected_quote_substring: substring that must appear in localized quote/spans
schema.content_type: native_text | figure_caption | table | scanned_or_image | scanned_ocr | low_text_layout
schema.mode: optional per-case override: localization | retrieval | both
